title: LegacyEnvelope
description: Minimal typed envelope for read-only historical Forge compatibility: opaque payload, provenance, & provisional mapping reference. Compatibility records never become canonical semantic owners.

legacyKind.description: Identifies a historical Forge record family wrapped for compatibility. Current mapping provenance lives under src/packages/arcane/compatibility/forge/.

payload.description: Opaque legacy payload, preserved byte-for-byte in structure. Intentionally unconstrained (no additionalProperties restriction) since its shape belongs to the legacy producer, not to this contract. For provenance.legacyInventoryRecordType == 'orthic.tool-receipt.v1', see the S00 report's explicit warning: the payload's 'signature_or_mac' field is a self-hash by the same untrusted process that built the receipt, not authentication — do not treat a non-null payload.signature_or_mac as proof of anything beyond payload integrity-at-capture.

importedBy.description: Identity of the translator/adapter that produced this envelope.

legacyInventoryRef.description: Path to the S00 inventory document that defines legacyKind's original field list, status vocabulary, and store mechanics. Reference target, not a shape to duplicate here.

legacyInventoryRecordType.description: The exact record_types entry name in legacyInventoryRef this payload corresponds to, when known (e.g. 'orthic.tool-receipt.v1').

authenticated.description: S00 finding (legacy-semantic-inventory.json, report §'What S03/S04/S05 will need to preserve or must NOT inherit as-is', item 1): every legacy Forge receipt's `signature_or_mac` is a self-hash with no secret key, MAC, or signature. A legacy envelope can therefore never assert real authentication — const false makes that structurally impossible to get wrong. Real authentication is expressed on the canonical objects that eventually incorporate this payload (legion-effect-receipt-v1.authentication, legion-evidence-capability-receipt-v1.authentication), never here.

provisionalMappingRef.description: Provisional reference into the canonical Legion object this legacy payload is believed to correspond to (e.g. an effect-receipt-v1 or evidence-capability-receipt-v1 id). Null until a mapping is proposed. 'Provisional' because final incorporation happens at coordinator seal (WP2 task brief), not here — a non-null value here is a hint, not an authoritative binding. S00's own report confirms it deliberately produced no canonical target mapping, consistent with this field staying provisional through WP2.
